description: Orion Robotics Team is a team from Colegio Ignacio Zaragoza, based in Saltillo, Coahuila, Mexico. Driven by curiosity, innovation, and a passion for science and tecnology, we are excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, taking on the "Flames in Freefall: SI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data" challenge. We aim to explore creative solutions, collaborate, and apply our knowledge to real-world scientific challenges.
